questions.text: Locate the public packaging.version.parse entry point.

targets.name: parse
targets.rationale: Constructs and returns a Version instance from the input string.

questions.text: Find the function that builds the default environment used by dependency markers.

targets.name: default_environment
targets.rationale: Collects interpreter, operating-system and platform values into the marker environment mapping.

questions.text: Where is packaging.utils.parse_wheel_filename defined?

targets.name: parse_wheel_filename
targets.rationale: Parses the distribution name, version, optional build number and compatibility tags.

questions.text: Locate Requirement._iter_parts, used to render dependency requirement strings.

targets.name: Requirement._iter_parts
targets.rationale: Yields the name, sorted extras, specifier, URL and marker text.

questions.text: Which implementation optionally validates a project name and normalizes its separators and case?

targets.name: canonicalize_name
targets.rationale: Checks _validate_regex when requested, substitutes separators with hyphens and lowercases the name.

questions.text: Where can trailing release zeros be preserved while canonicalizing a version string?

targets.name: canonicalize_version
targets.rationale: Only strips trailing .0 segments when strip_trailing_zero is true.

questions.text: Where does canonicalizing an unparseable legacy version return the original string instead of failing?

targets.name: canonicalize_version
targets.rationale: Catches InvalidVersion for string inputs and returns the original value.

questions.text: Which code expands compressed wheel interpreter, ABI and platform components into every tag combination?

targets.name: parse_tag
targets.rationale: Uses nested loops over dot-separated fields to build a frozenset of Tag objects.

questions.text: Where is a comma-separated constraint expression stripped of empty entries and stored as a deduplicated set?

targets.name: SpecifierSet.__init__
targets.rationale: Splits and strips nonempty expressions, maps Specifier over them and stores a frozenset.

questions.text: Which set-membership implementation treats an installed prerelease as its base version when requested?

targets.name: SpecifierSet.contains
targets.rationale: After the prerelease gate, installed prereleases are replaced by Version(item.base_version).

questions.text: Where is a missing or explicitly None extra environment value converted to an empty string for marker evaluation?

targets.name: Marker.evaluate
targets.rationale: Sets the default extra to an empty string and normalizes a None override.

questions.text: Which filename parser rejects source archives whose suffix is neither .tar.gz nor .zip?

targets.name: parse_sdist_filename
targets.rationale: Checks the two accepted suffixes and otherwise raises InvalidSdistFilename.

questions.text: Trace requirement construction to the grammar entry point that parses the dependency string.

targets.name: Requirement.__init__
targets.rationale: Calls the imported requirement parser and translates ParserSyntaxError into InvalidRequirement.

targets.name: parse_requirement
targets.rationale: Builds a Tokenizer and delegates to the requirement grammar.

targets.name: _parse_requirement
targets.rationale: Parses the name, extras and details and requires the end of input.

questions.text: Which requirement comparison calls project-name normalization in another module before comparing the remaining fields?

targets.name: Requirement.__eq__
targets.rationale: Normalizes both names before checking extras, specifiers, URLs and markers.

targets.name: canonicalize_name
targets.rationale: Provides the canonical project-name transformation used in equality.

questions.text: Trace compatibility-tag extraction from a wheel filename into the function that expands compressed tags.

targets.name: parse_wheel_filename
targets.rationale: Passes the final wheel filename segment to parse_tag.

targets.name: parse_tag
targets.rationale: Expands interpreter, ABI and platform combinations into Tag objects.

questions.text: Which source-archive parser constructs a Version object, and where is that version validated?

targets.name: parse_sdist_filename
targets.rationale: Splits the archive stem and constructs Version(version_part), translating invalid versions.

targets.name: Version.__init__
targets.rationale: Validates the version with a regex and creates normalized version components.

questions.text: Trace marker comparison to version-specifier membership when the right side forms a valid version constraint.

targets.name: _eval_op
targets.rationale: Constructs Specifier from the operator and right-hand value and calls contains with prereleases enabled.

targets.name: Specifier.contains
targets.rationale: Coerces the tested version and dispatches the selected comparison operation.

questions.text: Which constructor and parser entry point turn a marker string into its parsed expression tree?

targets.name: Marker.__init__
targets.rationale: Calls the imported marker parser, normalizes extras and translates syntax errors.

targets.name: parse_marker
targets.rationale: Creates the tokenizer and parses a complete marker expression.

questions.text: Where does single-specifier membership convert a string version using the implementation in the version module?

targets.name: Specifier.contains
targets.rationale: Calls _coerce_version before prerelease and comparison checks.

targets.name: _coerce_version
targets.rationale: Constructs Version only if the input is not already a Version.

targets.name: Version.__init__
targets.rationale: Parses and validates the string version used by the coercion helper.

questions.text: How does specifier canonicalization preserve release zeros for the compatible-release operator across modules?

targets.name: Specifier._canonical_spec
targets.rationale: Sets strip_trailing_zero to false for the ~= operator.

targets.name: canonicalize_version
targets.rationale: Honors the flag while rendering the parsed release components.

questions.text: Which test verifies that disabling trailing-zero stripping preserves versions such as 1.4.0?

targets.name: test_canonicalize_version_no_strip_trailing_zero
targets.rationale: Parametrizes 1.4.0 and 1.0 and asserts the canonicalized output equals the input.

questions.text: Find the test that rejects extras separated by whitespace rather than a comma.

targets.name: TestRequirementParsing.test_error_when_missing_comma_in_extras
targets.rationale: Parses name[bar baz] and checks the InvalidRequirement message and location.

questions.text: Which test verifies marker evaluation assumes an empty extra when no environment override is supplied?

targets.name: TestMarker.test_environment_assumes_empty_extra
targets.rationale: Checks that extra == im_valid evaluates to false in the default environment.

questions.text: Which test distinguishes PEP 440 version ordering from ordinary string ordering for marker operands?

targets.name: TestOperatorEvaluation.test_prefers_pep440
targets.rationale: Checks that version 2.7.9 compares below 2.7.10 through marker evaluation.
